# PowerPoint Factory

> Corporate-ready PowerPoint presentations as code. Typed Bun/TypeScript slide recipes → native editable .pptx (shapes, charts, tables, notes, titles, transitions, animations) → LibreOffice render to PDF/PNG → automatic QA. AI media via the Kubeez API. Built for AI agents (Claude Code) to write decks end to end.

Start with CLAUDE.md (rules, commands, the deck loop). Decks live in presentations/<company>/<project>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<deck>/ (deck.ts + slides/NN-name.ts, one slide per file); outputs in out/<same path>/. Run `bin/deck loop <deck>` and read out/<deck>/qa.md + contact-sheet.png.

## Core docs
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): agent rules, repo map, commands, the deck loop
- [README.md](README.md): overview, quickstart, sample output
- [docs/layouts.md](docs/layouts.md): every layout and its props
- [docs/deck-craft.md](docs/deck-craft.md): story structure, exhibit choice, chart/table rules, anti-AI-slop
- [docs/qa.md](docs/qa.md): every QA rule and its fix

## Media
- [docs/kubeez.md](docs/kubeez.md): Kubeez REST API (auth, async jobs, models, caching)
- [docs/image-prompts.md](docs/image-prompts.md): prompts for images/video/music that don't look AI-made

## Extending
- [docs/extending.md](docs/extending.md): DSL primitives, custom layouts, brands, themes
- [docs/motion.md](docs/motion.md): motion profiles (none/subtle/build/keynote), Morph, OOXML injection
- [docs/libraries.md](docs/libraries.md): wrapped libraries and upgrade paths

## Example
- [presentations/halden/BRAND.md](presentations/halden/BRAND.md): a complete company brand brief
- [presentations/halden/q4-business-review/2026-11-03/board-update/](presentations/halden/q4-business-review/2026-11-03/board-update/): a 21-slide board deck recipe
- [out/halden/q4-business-review/2026-11-03/board-update/board-update.pdf](out/halden/q4-business-review/2026-11-03/board-update/board-update.pdf): its rendered output
